name: Telluric-Tor

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Their vault-cities descend on tethered cables through the cloud decks, harvesting charge from the storms.

description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in an ancient meteor crater. Travelers navigate by magnetic pole anomalies and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
